tara (sec): alert from leak-detect: found KMS-wrapped blob in partner-archive pointing at our keyring. path: gs://partner-archive/2026-03-24/export-2026.enc
ben (infra): paste ciphertext header and any ACL info?
tara (sec): header: `KMS:projects/redwood-kms/locations/us-central1/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/partner-key-2026` ; bucket ACL shows partner-team@partner.com as OWNER, publicRead removed earlier but object ACL had allUsers briefly. unsure timeframe.
mike (platform): likely partner uploaded earlier via signed workflow. publicRead gap might be from partner bucket policy. partner still shouldn't be able to decrypt unless KMS grants exist.
oncall-bot: Triggering quick KMS IAM audit job (ben).
ben (infra): running `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy partner-key-2026 --location=us-central1 --keyring=partners` now.
vault-bot: vault-kms-sync last run 2026-03-20. No recent policy writes for partner-key-2026.
ben (infra): initial IAM shows encrypter/decrypter -> serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com ; no external accounts. group infra-admins has admin role.
tara (sec): ok blast radius limited. still follow rotation & quarantine: propose steps: 1) snapshot object to quarantine bucket 2) remove any leftover public ACLs on partner bucket 3) provision `partner-key-2026-rewrap` with minimal grant for rewrap-runner SA 4) rewrap blob and verify decrypt 5) audit-scan repo for any refs to key name / plaintext tokens 6) rotate any tokens if found
mike (platform): agree. I'll update ingestion workflow to avoid writing wrapped artifacts to partner buckets. Use internal archive + signed-url push.
ben (infra): opening PR infra/kms/partners/2026-03-rewrap to create rewrap key and add temporary binding.
oncall-bot: scheduling maintenance window 03:30 UTC for rewrap. oncall: mike
tara (sec): I'll own verification+compliance: store rewrap manifest at `secret/incidents/INC-2026-03-24-01/rewrap-manifest` in Vault and enable KMS data access sink for 90d.
ben (infra): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/2033  includes TF plan and rewrap instructions.
mike (platform): removed leftover public ACL and notified partner of short maintenance. partner acknowledged.
oncall-bot: smoke decrypt test planned post-rewrap.
tara (sec): final note: update partner onboarding checklist to require either partner-managed key or internal-only storage for ciphertext. Opening incident INC-2026-03-24-01 to track. Closing thread for now, follow-ups in incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
